summary: Tested the weekly Top Sharers leaderboard and admin top-3 reward, backend and frontend. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_top_sharers.py, 11/11 passed. It covers ranking (most friends first, ties go to the earliest signup), masked names, is_me/me, rejecting normal ?ref= signups without src, rejecting signups older than 7 days, rejecting referrers whose role is not user, 401 when logged out, 403 for staff and players on admin endpoints, amount validation (negative, all zero, >10000 -> 400; empty list or 4 items -> 422), reward rules (a $0 rank is skipped, promo_balance goes up, a sharer_reward tx is created with reference=run id, the run is listed, the demo player at rank 4 is not paid) and the 7-day cooldown (400). Frontend: player Top losses/Top sharers tabs (rows, values like '3 friends', masked 'De***o' with a YOU badge, my-position #4 for demo, not-ranked state, Share now link goes to /app/calculator). Admin /admin/top-sharers: full name/email table, defaults 25/15/10, confirm dialog, toast 'Paid $35.00 to 2 top sharers', run shows in Past rewards, second attempt shows the 7-day error toast. Staff has no nav item and is redirected away from /admin/top-sharers. Statement shows 'Top Sharer Reward'. Regression: the loss tab, calculator share and ShareStats still work, and test_bot_answers_ratings_share.py passed 4/4. Everything passed. Only minor issues remain.

minor.issue: A run is inserted even when winners is empty. Example: amounts [0,0,5] with only 1-2 ranked sharers gives total $0 but still starts the 7-day lock. Return 400 when no winners are paid.
The check-then-insert cooldown is not atomic. Two clicks at the same moment could pay twice. Consider a unique weekly key or findOneAndUpdate lock.
